sentences.text: Community is an American television sitcom created by Dan Harmon that aired on NBC and Yahoo! Screen from September 17 , 2009 to June 2 , 2015 .	Dan Harmon	Dan Harmon	NBC	NBC	Yahoo! Screen	Yahoo! Screen	sitcom	sitcom

The series follows an ensemble cast of characters played by Joel McHale , Gillian Jacobs , Danny Pudi , Yvette Nicole Brown , Alison Brie , Donald Glover , Ken Jeong , Chevy Chase , and Jim Rash at a community college in the fictional town of Greendale , Colorado .	Joel McHale	Joel McHale	Gillian Jacobs	Gillian Jacobs	Danny Pudi	Danny Pudi	Yvette Nicole Brown	Yvette Nicole Brown	Alison Brie	Alison Brie	Donald Glover	Donald Glover	Ken Jeong	Ken Jeong	Chevy Chase	Chevy Chase	Jim Rash	Jim Rash	community college	community college	Colorado	Colorado

It makes heavy use of meta-humor and pop culture references , often parodying film and television clichés and tropes .	meta-humor	Meta-joke	pop culture	popular culture	references	Meta-reference	tropes	trope (literature)
Harmon based the program on his own experiences attending a community college .	community college	community college
Each episode was written in accordance with Harmon 's `` story circle '' template , a methodology designed to create effective , structured storytelling .
Harmon served as the series ' showrunner for its first three seasons , but was fired prior to the fourth and replaced by writers David Guarascio and Moses Port .	showrunner	showrunner
After a lukewarm response from fans and critics , Harmon was re-hired for the show 's fifth broadcast season , after which it was cancelled by NBC .	NBC	NBC

Yahoo! Screen commissioned a sixth season , which premiered on March 17 , 2015 , and concluded on June 2 with the series finale .	Yahoo! Screen	Yahoo! Screen	the series finale	Emotional Consequences of Broadcast Television
Community received acclaim for its acting and writing , and appeared on numerous critics ' year-end `` best-of '' lists for 2009 , 2010 , and 2011 .

It developed a cult following , united by the mantra `` Six seasons and a movie '' , a line from the second-season episode `` Paradigms of Human Memory '' .	cult following	cult following	Paradigms of Human Memory	Paradigms of Human Memory
The show completed six seasons and a film adaptation is in development .

The show entered broadcast syndication in 2013 , was released on DVD , and has been available to stream through Hulu in the U.S. , Stan in Australia , and Netflix in the UK , Canada , Ireland , and Latin America .	broadcast syndication	broadcast syndication	DVD	DVD	Hulu	Hulu	Stan	Stan (streaming company)	Netflix	Netflix
